adapter: Actual StrandFight simulation + explicit DOM/Canvas fixture; not native browser or physical controller

checks.name: Only two distinct supported kits per side; mirror teams allowed
Atomic assistance/tag engagement and the last 25 Cohesion
Insufficient Cohesion refuses without a charge or partner appearance
Guard, hitstun, airborne and attack prevent voluntary tags
Control changes at tick 15 once; life and Chiral survive transfer
Reserve health never regenerates and tag cooldown prevents immediate reuse
Pause and hitstop freeze Cohesion and partner clocks
An arriving support can be hit and interrupted without refund
Support KO forbids subsequent assistance/tag and does not hurt its active ally
Assistance ends once and cooldown begins after its exit
A hit during tag departure interrupts the transfer without refund
Both camps can call independently while each camp keeps at most three projectiles
KO automatically transfers to the survivor with zero Cohesion and preserves resources
Projectile ownership and its Chiral reward remain with the emitter after tag
Crates become inert in reserve and expire instead of being cloned
Cliff post and Mama anchor are recalled on reserve entry
Time limit compares both health pools, not only the active fighters
Equal time preserves health; equal simultaneous hits do not favor a side
Exact final double KO ends in a draw without resurrection
Shared combo survives a tag and applies to subsequent partner damage
All eight assistance profiles run and leave the partner exactly once
Save/reload resumes the complete team state in pause with inputs released
Corrupt or incompatible team saves are rejected without changing live state
UI prevents duplicates, starts the engine, maps team keys, saves and resumes
Denied storage retains the playable fight in pause with an honest message
